records.title: AFP, PNP, PCG Strengthen Joint Peace and Security Coordination
AFP, PNP, PCG Sustain Joint Readiness Through 2026 Inter-Agency Exercise
AFP, PNP, PCG Strengthen Interagency Response Through Field Training Exercise
AFP, PNP, PCG Conclude Interagency Exercise “Pagsasanay Sanlakas” 2026

claims.statement: The closing account identifies this as IAX 02-2026, called Pagsasanay Sanlakas.

evidence.exact_excerpt: the second Interagency Exercise (IAX 02-2026), dubbed “Pagsasanay Sanlakas,”

claims.statement: The AFP describes the September 30–October 2 National Capital Region exercise as PCG-led.

evidence.exact_excerpt: Held from September 30 to October 2 in the National Capital Region, with the PCG as lead agency

claims.statement: The 2026 interagency exercise opening ceremony occurred September 30.

evidence.exact_excerpt: formally opened the 2026 Inter-Agency Exercise during a ceremony held on September 30

claims.statement: A field exercise occurred October 1 at HNTCEN-NCR in Intramuros, Manila.

evidence.exact_excerpt: Field Training Exercise (FTX) held on October 1 at the Humanitarian and Natural Disaster Training Center–National Capital Region (HNTCEN-NCR) in Intramuros, Manila

claims.statement: The closing ceremony was held October 2 at Eva Macapagal Super Terminal, Pier 15, Manila.

evidence.exact_excerpt: on October 2, 2026, at the Eva Macapagal Super Terminal, Pier 15, Port Area, Manila

claims.statement: The AFP closing account reports more than 530 participating personnel in tabletop and field exercises simulating a large earthquake.

evidence.exact_excerpt: More than 530 personnel participated in tabletop and field training exercises simulating a large-scale earthquake

claims.statement: The AFP lists search-and-rescue, humanitarian assistance, triage and maritime casualty evacuation scenarios.

evidence.exact_excerpt: search and rescue, humanitarian assistance, triage, and maritime casualty evacuation

claims.statement: The AFP describes the joint AFP–PNP–PCG education, training and doctrine cell as the exercise organizer.

evidence.exact_excerpt: Joint AFP-PNP-PCG Education, Training and Doctrine Cell (JAPPETDC)

claims.statement: AFP describes a sixth JPSCC meeting held September 29 in Malate, Manila.

evidence.exact_excerpt: 6th National Joint Peace and Security Coordinating Center (JPSCC) Meeting on September 29 in Malate, Manila

claims.statement: AFP reports the meeting included signing a National JPSCC Cyber Plan.

evidence.exact_excerpt: signing of the National JPSCC Cyber Plan

claims.statement: The AFP account connects the JPSCC cyber-coordination plan to security concerns in the West Philippine Sea.

evidence.exact_excerpt: particularly in addressing security concerns in the West Philippine Sea

editorial_review_flags.note: Record 1390 is a September 29 JPSCC meeting and cyber-plan signing, not an opening/field/closing stage of Sanlakas. Shared AFP/PNP/PCG participants do not imply event identity.
The JPSCC article spells the PCG commandant Ronnie Gil L. Galvan; the exercise closing article spells Ronnie Gil L. Gavan. Do not silently collapse these person strings into one canonical entity.
Three exercise reports are all published by AFP PAO, so they provide a multi-record chronology but not three independent institutional confirmations.
The event's stage dates and the AFP release dates differ. Timeline should index event dates separately from release dates and captured-at timestamps.
AFP API response indexing header and source terms/rights require separate editorial review; this candidate only references preserved hashes and short snippets.

AFP opening story afp:1391 has a Camp Aguinaldo/Quezon City dateline and uses 'here' for the September 30 opening; publicly indexed PCG reporting places the opening at PCG National Headquarters. Do not assign a verified opening venue or coordinates without independent original-source review. Third-party and social search results are not pinned archive evidence.

verification_scope: offline exact pinned historical source and excerpt substring matches; no independent factual corroboration
